items.name: Hive Pack
items.why: Increases the damage of friendly bees.
items.notes: The Hive Pack can actually reduce the DPS of the Beekeeper and Hive-Five because they do not rely on bees as their primary source of damage, so it is not recommended to be used by melee damage users.
